## ColumnType type

The dialect-neutral column types a [Blueprint](./database.blueprint.md) can declare.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ColumnType = 'increments' | 'string' | 'text' | 'integer' | 'bigInteger' | 'boolean' | 'float' | 'decimal' | 'date' | 'timestamp' | 'json' | 'uuid';
```

## Remarks

Each grammar maps these onto its own type names — `json` becomes `jsonb` on Postgres, `json` on MySQL and `text` on sqlite, for instance. `increments` is not declared directly; use [Blueprint.id()](./database.blueprint.id.md)<!-- -->.
